ques: My father has diabetes and needs a blood sugar monitor and test strips for use at home. Help him understand what Medicare covers before he buys them: which part covers each item, what prescription or supplier requirements apply, and what share he pays after the deductible if the supplier accepts assignment. Include the 2026 annual deductible so he can budget for these supplies.
judge_rubric: Use the monitor and test-strip coverage information and 2026 costs. Explain Part B coverage, a prescribed home-use monitor, Medicare-enrolled doctors and suppliers and assignment, the 20% share after the deductible for both items, and the annual Part B deductible. Keep the item and cost relationships correct; no state changes.

ques: My grandfather is having hip replacement surgery and may move to a skilled nursing facility (SNF). Work out his 2026 costs: the Part A deductible per inpatient hospital benefit period, the yearly Part B deductible, what he pays per day for inpatient hospital days 1-60 after paying it, and the daily coinsurance for SNF days 21-100. Then check the SNF rules: how many inpatient hospital days qualify him, can an ACO waiver replace that requirement, how many SNF days does a benefit period cover, and is the Part A deductible charged again for SNF care in the same period?
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: The agent must open the Medicare costs page and the Skilled nursing facility care coverage detail page. The answer must state the 2026 Part A deductible per inpatient hospital benefit period, the yearly Part B deductible, the per-day cost for inpatient hospital days 1-60, the daily coinsurance for skilled nursing facility days 21-100, and the SNF rules: how many inpatient hospital days qualify him, whether an ACO waiver can replace that requirement, how many SNF days a benefit period covers, and whether the Part A deductible is charged again for SNF care in the same period. An answer missing any part, or an empty answer, is a FAIL.

ques: My aunt in Boston wants a family doctor who accepts Medicare assignment and offers telehealth. Compare Bailey Walker Goodwin and Clinton K. Pong in the provider directory: establish whether each meets those needs, explain the medical-school and graduation-year information listed for each, and give the office phone number so she can arrange an appointment.
judge_rubric: Compare both named clinicians using their detail pages. For each, report assignment and telehealth availability, medical school (including an honest 'Other' / unspecified answer where applicable), graduation year, and contact phone. Bind each fact to the correct clinician. No state changes.

ques: My father is choosing between St Johns Hospital and Memorial Medical Center in Springfield, IL. Compare their overall ratings, ownership, and reported safety-measure counts, then recommend the higher-rated hospital and give its phone number. He wants to understand those differences before discussing the choice with his surgeon.
judge_rubric: Compare both named hospital details. Bind each rating, ownership and safety-measure count to its hospital; recommend the higher-rated hospital and give its phone. Do not treat the number of reported safety measures as a safety score. No state changes.

ques: My mother is returning home to Denver after a hospital stay and needs a walker. Check whether Medicare covers a prescribed walker for use at home and explain her share of the cost and the supplier requirements. Find the closest supplier listed for walkers in ZIP 80204 and give its name, phone number, and whether it accepts Medicare assignment so we can contact it.
judge_rubric: Use walker coverage and the ZIP 80204 walker supplier results. Explain prescribed medically necessary home-use Part B DME, 20% after deductible when assignment is accepted, and Medicare enrollment of doctors and suppliers. Identify the nearest matching supplier, phone, and assignment status. No state changes.

ques: My mother in ZIP 62701 is comparing Aetna Medicare Premier (HMO) with Blue Cross Medicare Classic (PPO) for 2026. She can budget up to $60 a month for the plan premium and wants an in-network out-of-pocket limit below $7,000. Compare both plans' premiums, medical deductibles, out-of-pocket limits and star ratings, and recommend the one that meets both limits. Explain whether she must keep paying her Part B premium. She also values an over-the-counter allowance and access to a 24/7 nurse line; tell her which of these benefits each plan lists.
judge_rubric: Compare the two named plans for ZIP 62701: premium, medical deductible, in-network out-of-pocket limit, rating. Recommend the plan satisfying both stated limits; state that the Part B premium continues. Do not imply a plan enrollment occurred. No state changes. Check the full benefits: associate the over-the-counter allowance with Aetna and the 24/7 nurse line with Blue Cross.

ques: My neighbor wants two printed copies of the Medicare & You 2027 handbook to work through with her caregiver. Without logging in, order 2 Standard Print copies to 12 Elm Court, Denver, CO 80204. Confirm the publication, quantity, format, and delivery address shown on the order confirmation.
judge_rubric: Persist exactly one anonymous handbook order with the requested quantity, format and full address. Reach its confirmation and accurately summarize those fields. Preserve every other row; viewing an order form or claiming success alone is insufficient.

ques: Alice has a message saying her Medicare Summary Notice is ready. Log in with alice.j@test.com / TestPass123!, read that notice message to establish its service period, and reconcile the July screening colonoscopy and blood sugar test strips claims within that period. Report the period, what Medicare paid and what Alice may be billed for each claim, and the total she may be billed across the two.
judge_rubric: Read Alice’s Summary Notice message and identify its June–August 2026 service period. Associate the Medicare paid and patient-billed amounts with each requested claim and compute the combined patient amount. Mark only the Summary Notice message read; preserve all other non-login data. Claim-list evidence is acceptable for the amounts.

ques: Bob wants to settle his outstanding Part B premium. Log in with bob.c@test.com / TestPass123!, identify the bill that is still due, and pay it using the default payment method. Confirm its amount, due date, payment method, and paid status while leaving the previously paid bill unchanged.
judge_rubric: Sign in as Bob. Pay only his outstanding bill using his default method. Report its amount, due date, method and paid status; preserve all previous bill details and all unrelated state.

ques: Alice just moved and lost her Medicare card in the move. Log in with the demo account (email: alice.j@test.com, password: TestPass123!). Update the mailing address to 45 Meadow Lane, Buffalo Grove, IL 60089 and confirm the new address is shown in account settings. Then order a free replacement card with "My card was lost" as the reason. Report the Medicare Number on her current card and the replacement card status.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: The agent must log in with the demo account (alice.j@test.com / TestPass123!), update the mailing address to 45 Meadow Lane, Buffalo Grove, IL 60089 and confirm it shows in account settings, then order a free replacement Medicare card with 'My card was lost' as the reason on-site. The answer must report the Medicare Number on her current card and the replacement card status. An answer missing any part, an empty answer, or an answer without the on-site address change and replacement order, is a FAIL.

ques: Alice is gathering printed guidance to discuss cancer-treatment coverage and supplemental insurance with her family. Log in with alice.j@test.com / TestPass123! and send 2 Standard Print copies of Medicare Coverage of Cancer Treatment Services and 1 Large Print copy of Choosing a Medigap Policy to her address on file. Confirm both orders with their product numbers, formats, quantities and delivery address.
judge_rubric: Sign in as Alice and persist exactly the two requested publication orders at her saved address. Summarize each publication's product number, quantity and format and the delivery address. Preserve all previous orders and unrelated state.

ques: I need a printed guide to understand how to appeal a Medicare decision. Without logging in, find the English Medicare Appeals booklet in the Rights and protections publications category and order one Large Print copy to 302 W Edwards St, Springfield, IL 62704. Confirm its product number, format and delivery address when the order is accepted.
judge_rubric: Use the English Rights and protections catalog to identify the appeals guide; persist exactly one anonymous Large Print order to the stated address. Confirm its product number, format and full address. Preserve unrelated data.

ques: Help Alice act on her newest unread Medicare message. Log in with alice.j@test.com / TestPass123!, open that message, and explain its subject, the enrollment dates it announces, and what coverage changes she can make during that period. Leave the other unread message unread.
judge_rubric: Sign in as Alice, open the initially newest unread message and explain its subject, enrollment dates (including the year), and joining, switching or dropping Medicare Advantage or drug coverage. Mark only that message read; the other initially unread message remains unread. No premium or profile changes.

ques: My grandfather's doctors have confirmed he's eligible for hospice care, with a life expectancy of 6 months or less. Look up hospice care in the coverage database: which part of Medicare must he have, who must certify that he's terminally ill, and what does he pay for hospice care from a Medicare-approved hospice? Then use the provider directory to find hospice care near Houston, TX — open the first hospice listed and report its name and phone number. Report everything together.
judge_rubric: Use hospice coverage and the Houston hospice directory. Report Part A, certification by hospice doctor and regular doctor if any, zero hospice-care cost and up-to-$5 outpatient drug copayment. Identify and open the first closest hospice with name and phone. No state changes.

ques: My father just turned 65 and has received Social Security retirement benefits since age 62. Help him understand how to start Medicare: whether enrollment is automatic, which agency handles Part A and Part B enrollment if he needs help, and Medicare's TTY contact number. Explain the 2026 standard monthly Part B premium, annual Part B deductible, and Part A deductible per benefit period so he can budget for his new coverage.
judge_rubric: Use Medicare enrollment, costs and contact information. Explain automatic enrollment for this Social Security recipient, SSA's Part A/B enrollment role, Medicare's TTY number, and correct 2026 Part B monthly premium, annual deductible and Part A benefit-period deductible. No state changes.
